title: DNS Resolution Fails through the Public Service Edge for Internet & SaaS

blocks.text: Zscaler Client Connector version 4.0 for Android has a known issue where DNS resolution through the Public Service Edge for Internet & SaaS would sometimes fail if DNS domains aren’t added to the Domain Inclusion field in App Profiles.
As a workaround, you can specify a wildcard (*) in the Domain Inclusion field in App Profiles:

blocks.item: From the navigation menu, go to Infrastructure > Client Connector > Android.
Click Add Android Policy. The Add Android Policy window appears.
In the Traffic Steering section, click the DNS tab.
In the Domain Inclusion field, enter a wildcard (*) to have Zscaler Client Connector tunnel all DNS domains through Internet & SaaS.
